tables.description:
Core order table for a Brazilian e-commerce marketplace (Olist). Each row is one order. Contains 99,441 orders.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- order_id: unique identifier for each order (TEXT UUID)
- customer_id: links to customers table
- order_status: lifecycle state — 'delivered' (most common), 'shipped', 'processing', 'canceled', 'approved', 'invoiced', 'unavailable'
- order_purchase_timestamp: when the customer placed the order (TEXT, e.g. '2018-01-15 12:34:56'). Use STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) for year
- order_approved_at: when payment was approved
- order_delivered_carrier_date: when order was handed to carrier
- order_delivered_customer_date: when customer actually received the order
- order_estimated_delivery_date: promised delivery date

COMMON QUERY PATTERNS (SQLite):
- Delivery time: JULIANDAY(order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(order_purchase_timestamp)
- Late deliveries: order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date
- Approval time: JULIANDAY(order_approved_at) - JULIANDAY(order_purchase_timestamp)
- Filter by year: STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'
- Monthly counts: STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp)
- Cancelled orders: order_status = 'canceled'

Line items within each order. Each row is one product in one order. Contains 112,650 rows. Multiple rows can share the same order_id if an order has multiple items.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- order_id: links to orders table
- order_item_id: position of item within the order (1, 2, 3...)
- product_id: links to products table
- seller_id: links to sellers table
- price: item sale price in BRL (Brazilian Reals)
- freight_value: shipping cost for this item in BRL

REVENUE FORMULA: SUM(price) for revenue, SUM(freight_value) for freight costs
ITEMS PER ORDER: COUNT(order_item_id) grouped by order_id
TOTAL ORDER VALUE: SUM(price + freight_value)

Payment transactions for each order. Multiple rows per order if payment was split. Contains 103,886 rows.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- order_id: links to orders table
- payment_sequential: sequence number when payment is split (1, 2, 3...)
- payment_type: method of payment — 'credit_card' (most common), 'boleto' (bank slip), 'voucher', 'debit_card'
- payment_installments: number of installments (1 = paid in full, higher = split over months)
- payment_value: amount paid in this transaction in BRL

REVENUE BY PAYMENT TYPE: SUM(payment_value) GROUP BY payment_type
MOST COMMON PAYMENT: COUNT(*) GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY count DESC

Customer satisfaction reviews for orders. Contains 98,410 reviews after deduplication.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- review_id: unique review identifier
- order_id: links to orders table
- review_score: star rating from 1 to 5 (INTEGER). 5 = best, 1 = worst
- review_comment_title: short title (often NULL)
- review_comment_message: free-text review body (often NULL)
- review_creation_date: when the review was created
- review_answer_timestamp: when the seller responded

5-STAR PERCENTAGE: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_score=5) / COUNT(*) * 100
AVERAGE SCORE BY CATEGORY: JOIN order_items and products, GROUP BY product_category_name
BAD SELLERS: sellers with AVG(review_score) < 3

Customer dimension table. Contains 99,441 customers (one per order — customer_id is order-specific; customer_unique_id identifies the same person across orders).

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- customer_id: order-level customer ID (links to orders.customer_id)
- customer_unique_id: true unique customer identifier (one person may have multiple customer_ids)
- customer_zip_code_prefix: first 5 digits of Brazilian postal code
- customer_city: city name (e.g. 'sao paulo', 'rio de janeiro', 'belo horizonte')
- customer_state: Brazilian state code (e.g. 'SP', 'RJ', 'MG', 'BA', 'RS', 'PR', 'SC')

MOST CUSTOMERS BY STATE: COUNT(*) GROUP BY customer_state
CITIES WITH MOST CUSTOMERS: COUNT(*) GROUP BY customer_city

Product catalog. Contains 32,951 products. Categories are in Portuguese.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- product_id: unique product identifier (links to order_items.product_id)
- product_category_name: Portuguese category name (e.g. 'cama_mesa_banho'=bed/bath, 'beleza_saude'=beauty/health, 'esporte_lazer'=sports, 'moveis_decoracao'=furniture, 'informatica_acessorios'=electronics/accessories, 'utilidades_domesticas'=home appliances, 'relogios_presentes'=watches/gifts, 'ferramentas_jardim'=tools/garden)
- product_weight_g: weight in grams
- product_length_cm, product_height_cm, product_width_cm: dimensions in centimeters

TO FIND REVENUE BY CATEGORY: JOIN order_items ON product_id, SUM(price) GROUP BY product_category_name
HIGHEST AVERAGE ORDER VALUE: AVG(price) per product_category_name

Seller dimension table. Contains 3,095 sellers on the Olist marketplace.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- seller_id: unique seller identifier (links to order_items.seller_id)
- seller_zip_code_prefix: first 5 digits of Brazilian postal code
- seller_city: seller's city (e.g. 'sao paulo', 'curitiba', 'belo horizonte')
- seller_state: Brazilian state code (e.g. 'SP', 'PR', 'MG')

TOP SELLERS BY REVENUE: JOIN order_items ON seller_id, SUM(price)
SELLER REVIEW SCORES: JOIN order_items -> orders -> order_reviews, AVG(review_score)

Brazilian zip code to lat/lng lookup table. Contains 1,000,163 rows (multiple coordinates per zip prefix). Typically not needed for most business queries — use customer_state or seller_state directly from customers and sellers tables instead.
